title: 9 Prairie Pass | Benchmark Management Vacation Rental
meta_description: 9 Prairie Pass is a 3.00 bedroom, 2.50 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: A beautiful coastal home located in NatureWalk where you'll be surrounded by the mature pine trees of Point Washington State Forest and enjoy quick and easy access to all of the wonderful amenities that NatureWalk has to offer.At 9 Prairie Pass you'll find 3 bedrooms and 2.5 bathrooms. This luxurious beach retreat has a gourmet kitchen that opens to the living area with large sectional. There is amazing attention to detail in all of the finishes. The main floor includes the living and dining area plus kitchen. There's an expansive screened porch on the 1st floor so you can enjoy the outdoors without having to deal with all the bugs. Upstairs you'll find all 3 bedrooms and the washer/dryer.Sleeping Arrangements:2nd Floor, Bedroom 1: Full-over-full bunkbed with twin trundle2nd Floor, Bedroom 2: Full bed. Shares hallway bath with Bedroom 1.2nd Floor, Bedroom 3: King bed, private balcony access. Private bathroom with dual sinks and large glass enclosed shower.NatureWalk:With a stay in NatureWalk, you have access to so many community amenities: multiple pools, a hot tub, grills, fire pits, and a community center known as the Gathering Place. There are also pickleball and basketball courts, walking trails, a volleyball sand pit, and an outdoor children’s park within the community. NatureWalk's perfect location puts you minutes from WaterColor and Seaside, where you can enjoy countless options for shopping, dining, and entertainment. A dip in the waters of the Gulf of Mexico is just a few minutes away.Your stay at 9 Prairie Pass comes with Xplorie’s best activities! one ticket per day, per activity! (over $800 in nightly value) Tee off at Emerald Bay or Regatta Bay, zip through Baytowne Adventure Zone, and sail on the Sea Blaster Dolphin Cruise. Enjoy Big Kahuna’s Water Park, Black Light Mini Golf, and scenic bike rides with complimentary rentals. Explore 30A with ease and adventure!* Sorry, no pets allowed* Parking for 2 cars in driveway (no garage access).An initial Benchmark signature box of amenities is provided for all guests. For the kitchen this includes: 1 roll of paper towels, 1 dish sponge, 1 dish soap, 2 dishwasher pods, 1 pack of kitchen wipes and liners for each trashcan plus 2 washing machine pods. For each bathroom it includes: 1 roll of toilet paper, 1 set of facial and bath soaps/body wash/shampoo/conditioner/lotion. For towels you will receive: 1 body towel/1 washcloth per guest and 2 hand towels per bathroom.
